product.name: Chilled biologic (teaching category)
product.description: Single product category used by the teaching prototype. Not a real product.

duration_rule.semantics: High excursion: temperature strictly above max_temp_c for at least high_excursion_min_duration_min minutes. Low excursion: temperature strictly below min_temp_c for at least low_excursion_min_duration_min minutes.

missing_data_rule.semantics: A gap between readings longer than gap_unknown_after_min minutes is UNKNOWN (never treated as safe). A gap of at least gap_review_at_min minutes requires quality review.

policy.disclaimer: Simulated teaching rule, not a regulatory safety standard. No ML output establishes product safety.
policy.approval_reference: Approved by the project owner in the Milestone 1 instructions (2026-11-14): 2-8 C range; above 8 C for at least 30 min; below 2 C for at least 15 min; gap > 15 min UNKNOWN; gap >= 30 min quality review; only the authorized Quality Officer approves release.
